description: Copy-paste inputs for the two Compose actions of the Power Platform Pipelines record flow (README.md, steps 3 and 4). stageRunFacts is the only place you pick dynamic content from the trigger: replace each PICK value with the matching trigger output in the designer. recordBody then needs no change: its expressions read stageRunFacts and build the record endpoint body. Not run in a real host: the output names and status words of OnDeploymentCompleted are UNVERIFIED here (README.md, What is not verified). The local test checks that recordBody has exactly the fields of fixtures/deployment.json.

stageRunFacts.stageRunId: PICK: the deployment stage run ID
stageRunFacts.startedOn: PICK: when the stage run started
stageRunFacts.finishedOn: PICK: when the stage run ended, or leave empty
